paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
... hamba bernama taru kaliyambang, daun berkarakter sedang (dumelada), akar berkarakter panas, kulit kayu berkarakter hangat, menjadi obat penyakit tuju cika (rematik/pegal linu), daunnya dipakai boreh (balur).
Hamba bernama taru sangket, watak hamba panas-dingin (sedang), daunnya dapat menjadi obat tuju brahma, dipakai sebagai boreh (balur), dicampur daun terung, sinduk putih, adas, dan minyak kelapa tanusan.
Hamba bernama taru belimbing buluh (belimbing wuluh), watak hamba dingin, daunnya dijadikan boreh obat panas/demam, dicampur daun terung bulat, beras merah, dan temutemu.

[Lembar 2]
Hamba bernama taru jeruk lengis, daunnya berkarakter panas, menjadi obat tuju empu, dipakai sebagai boreh (balur), dicampur kulit kayu klembak, temu tis, dan garam abu.
Hamba bernama taru sembung gantung, daunnya berkarakter panas, menjadi obat batuk berdarah, diminum sebagai ramuan loloh.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
... I am taru kaliyambang, leaves are neutral/moderate, roots are hot, bark is warm, a remedy for tuju cika ailments; its leaves are used as an external boreh paste.
I am taru sangket, my nature is hot-cold (moderate), my leaves can serve as medicine for tuju brahma, applied as a boreh poultice, combined with eggplant leaves, white sinduk, fennel/adas, and tanusan coconut oil.
I am taru belimbing buluh, my nature is cool, my leaves serve as a boreh poultice to cure heat/fever, mixed with round eggplant leaves, red rice, and temutemu rhizomes.

[Leaf 2]
I am taru juwuk lengis, leaves are hot, remedy for tuju empu, used as a boreh poultice, mixed with klembak bark, temu tis, and ash salt.
I am taru sembung gantung, leaves are hot, a cure for coughing blood (hemoptysis), consumed as a medicinal loloh drink.

paleography.transliteration:
Iki Usadha Taru Pramana, ngaran, kagnanira mpu Kuturan, kawitnya ring Ba-
linggih, tkapira Bhaṭara Guru, katur ring Bhaṭara Brahmā, Bhaṭara Wisnu, tka ring sa-
hananing wṛkṣa, taru, latā, tṛṇa, sami mangkana, padrbyanira Sang Hyang Saraswatī, kawruhanta ring sa-
hananing taru, yanya panus, tisin, dumêlada, kawruhakêna, yanya phalanya, donya, babakan,
paleography.indonesian_translation: Inilah Usadha Taru Pramana, namanya, karya dari Mpu Kuturan, permulaannya di Balinggih, oleh Bhatara Guru, dipersembahkan kepada Bhatara Brahma, Bhatara Wisnu, sampai kepada segala pepohonan, pohon kayu, tumbuhan merambat, dan rumput-rumputan, semuanya demikian, kepunyaan Sang Hyang Saraswati, ketahuilah olehmu tentang segala pepohonan, apakah bersifat panas, dingin, atau sedang, ketahuilah, baik itu buahnya, daunnya, kulit kayunya,
paleography.english_translation: This is Usadha Taru Pramana, its name, composed by Mpu Kuturan, originating in Balinggih, by Bhatara Guru, offered to Bhatara Brahma, Bhatara Wisnu, down to all kinds of trees, woody plants, creepers, and grasses, all as such, belonging to Sang Hyang Saraswati, know ye about all trees/plants, whether they are hot, cold, or temperate, understand them, whether regarding their fruits, leaves, or bark,

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Teks memuat bagian pembuka/pendahuluan naskah Usadha Taru Pramana karya Mpu Kuturan mengenai hakikat khasiat dan sifat tumbuhan (panas, dingin, sedang; daun, buah, kulit kayu) tanpa resep racikan pengobatan spesifik.
